en.t: I am certainly not going to become a geisha.

units.source_text: 我不过是个哄孩子的嘛。”

en.t: I am only someone who looks after children, after all.”

units.source_text: 阿雪唱歌似的说罢，连仓吉也用目光追索着她那袅娜的舞姿，和着拍子拍打着裸露的大腿。

en.t: After A-Xue said this as if singing, even Kurakichi followed her graceful dancing figure with his eyes and slapped his bare thighs in time with the rhythm.

units.source_text: 这么一来，阿雪只好迁就他那凌乱的节拍跳舞了。

en.t: At that, A-Xue had no choice but to adjust her dancing to his ragged beat.

units.source_text: 她跳得腿肚子周围都发热了，越跳越乱，

en.t: She danced until the area around her calves grew hot, and the more she danced, the more disordered her steps became,

units.source_text: 刚要转身，却摇晃了几下，

en.t: just as she was about to turn around, she swayed several times,

units.source_text: 竟跌坐在堆得高高的坐垫上，眼看就要倒向五屉柜那边。

en.t: and finally dropped down onto the cushions piled high behind her, looking as though she would topple toward the five-drawer chest at any moment.
